batch_G.scope: SEC-001 router auth enforcement, SEC-002 apply checklist, doc-merge deletions, TEST-002 conftest fix
batch_G.headline: The documented default invocation was vacuous before this batch: `python -m pytest` reported '16263 skipped, 3500 deselected, 0 passed in 125.96s' because tests/integration/k8s/conftest.py skipped every item in the session (TEST-002). After fixing that hook the suite actually executes.

targeted.note: These assert 401 on /tools/*, /sandbox/*, /recon/*. They could not have passed before this batch — no router referenced get_required_auth. 401 short-circuits before DB access, so no Postgres needed.

full_offline_suite.result: 13223 passed, 359 failed, 1050 errors, 1635 skipped, 3500 deselected, 1 xfailed
full_offline_suite.regression_analysis: Grepped the whole run for 401 / 'Authentication required': exactly 4 hits, all in tests/unit/api/test_scan_findings_export.py. Root cause: tests/unit/conftest.py shadows the root override_auth with a no-op, so those router tests hit the now-protected scans router unauthenticated. Fixed by adding tests/unit/api/conftest.py restoring the override for that package (it is the only package under tests/unit that drives real routers via the client fixture). All 4 now pass. No other failure in the run mentions auth.
full_offline_suite.caveat: These totals are a first honest baseline, not a green build. They were previously invisible because the whole suite was being skipped. Triaging the 359 failures / 1050 errors is follow-up work, not part of this batch.

incidental_test_fixes.change: Path-filter pytest_collection_modifyitems so it only marks items in its own package (TEST-002).
New — restores the get_required_auth override for router tests in this package.
mock_finding fixture now sets cvss_vector / exploit_summary (both str|None on the model); stale fixture drift surfaced once the suite started running.
